messages:
Lina: Ok team — prepping Wave 3 preview cohort launch next week. Need a quick sync on seat enrollments, enablement, and renewal-risk signals. TL;DR: 10 customers, staggered start 4/7-4/9, want post-demo survey + 2-week health check. Who owns comms, training, and follow-up?

Raj: I can handle comms + the invite template. Do we reuse the generic preview invite or do a short custom blurb per customer?

Noor: I’ll run training — planning 3 office hours (30m each). Prefer Wed/Thu mornings PT. Can you share the final attendee list so I can slot them? :calendar:

Jenna: Uploading the roster now — a few customers asked for SSO walkthrough and API key steps. I’ll annotate the list with flags. Link in a sec.

Sam: Legal quick note — we should append a one-paragraph addendum to the NDA about telemetry/log use during the preview. I can review and sign off by EOD if we have the draft.

Lina: Perfect. Raj pls draft invite by EOD; Noor pls schedule office hours and share the calendar invites; Jenna pls flag SSO/API customers and their assigned AMs. Also need a simple survey + health-signal playbook for CSMs — @Maya can you own signals and thresholds?

Maya: Yep. I’ll publish a one-pager rubric: engagement (demo completion, office-hour attendance), error rate (>=1% fail -> yellow), latency regressions, and prompt-quality drop (per our eval set). Will attach a short prompt set and rubric.

Raj: Draft invite (short):
```
Subject: Redwood Preview — quick intro + setup
Hi <Contact>,
Thanks for joining our preview cohort. We’ll schedule a 30m kickoff to demo, confirm SSO/API access, and note any integration constraints. Please pick a slot here: <cal link>. Expect a follow-up survey after the session.
Best,
Raj (Customer Success)
```

Noor: Office hours proposed slots: Wed 9:30–10:00 PT, Wed 11:00–11:30 PT, Thu 8:30–9:00 PT. I’ll post in ops and create a shared calendar.

Jenna: Roster uploaded: https://drive.redwood/example-wave3-roster (flag column: SSO/API/High-usage). Also added notes where they requested dedicated SSO time.

Maya: Health-signal thresholds I’m proposing: demo completion < 50% => amber; demo completion < 25% => red. Error spike (>1% across requests) => amber, >3% => red. Negative survey (avg < 3/5) => red. I’ll create a tracking tab.

Raj: Survey drafted (short): 1) How useful was the demo? (1-5) 2) Any blockers? 3) Would you recommend continuing? Link: https://forms.gle/preview-wave3-survey

Sam: Add legal consent line to the invite: "By participating you consent to aggregated telemetry collection for product improvement; no customer-identifiable data will be published." I’ll post the final language.

Lina: Good call. Also propose we set auto renewal-risk tags in Salesforce: missed first-week check -> amber; missed + negative survey or major integration blockers -> red. Thoughts?

Maya: Sounds good. I’ll push a notifier that flags CSMs when a customer enters amber so we can remediate quickly.

Noor: I’ll prioritize office hours for flagged customers (first come, first served).

Jenna: FYI one customer needs dedicated API key rotation instructions — will add to the invite and tag the infra contact.

Raj: I’ll post the invite templates in /templates/preview-invite and ping the AMs.

calendar-bot: Event created: Wave 3 Preview Kickoffs — 4/7 to 4/9 (10 slots)

Lina: Thanks all. Next quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to confirm invites + legal copy. If there are blockers DM me. :rocket:
